intent.goal: Keep comprehensive, accurate documentation of GitHub remote MCP tools and changes.
intent.acceptance: Partial native factual facet: the three claimed JSON-mapping quantities equal the independent JSON blob at the immutable run head. Duplicate registrations remain distinct from unique tool names.

profile.authoring: Outcome-informed retrospective: source and candidate prose exposed before this explicit native-facet contract. Latest surviving marker-discovered report selected, not a representative or blind sample.

originalCensusProposal.goal: Keep comprehensive, accurate documentation of GitHub remote MCP tools and changes.
originalCensusProposal.population: Advertised tools in the configured remote all-toolsets server and their source mapping at immutable versions.
originalCensusProposal.acceptance: Tool descriptions and mappings must independently match actual advertised behavior; a comprehensive-looking inventory is not sufficient.
originalCensusProposal.evidencePlan: Preserve authoritative tool-schema/source snapshots and establish independent documentation-to-behavior conformance checks.
originalCensusProposal.missingReason: No independent tool-behavior/documentation verification corpus was collected; discovery counts alone cannot validate descriptions or usefulness.

grounding.quote: Generate a comprehensive report of all tools/functions available in the GitHub MCP remote server by self-inspecting the available tools and creating detailed documentation.

originalCensusProposal.limitation: Tool/report counts and generated mapping entries are output volume rather than documentation benefit.

profile.historicalCompatibility: Only the retained run-head profile is evaluated; earlier periods are unmeasured.
profile.baseline: Actual source addition verified against its real parent, not first output or shallow boundary. No comparable outcome baseline reconstructed.

evidence.opportunity: Three explicitly repository-mapping facts: unique tool names, total registration entries and toolset categories in the latest surviving report.
filters: Latest surviving pre-cutoff Discussion with this exact workflow marker in the already fully acquired inventory. One selected report per workflow; all other reports remain unassessed. No random, representative, blind or complete-lifetime claim.
Only this retained run-head source era; current worker assignment requirements are not backdated.
evidence.collection: Offline deterministic original-byte verification and native oracle; no model, Git, network, target execution, or current body/state backdating.
